Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Cylinder Stoneware Watering Can Vase Set - Pack of 2, Multicolor
Materials: stoneware
Accent your modern-style home décor with these beautiful stoneware vases. Perfect for holding cut flowers, these vases come in two sizes to fit different spaces, and their earthenware look blends well with many décor styles, include contemporary, farmhouse, and rustic. Large vase: 5.75"L x 8"W x 9.5"H; small vase: 4.5"L x 6.26"W x 7.6"H Made of 100% stoneware These vases feature a delicate geometric design around their exteriors that enhances their rustic look.
